subject.title: System prompt: add guidance for spawning background sub-agents

question: Should this PR continue as broad default OpenClaw Tooling prompt guidance, or should sub-agent delegation policy stay in the existing config-gated section and narrower Codex-specific guardrails?
rationale: Both choices intentionally affect model-visible delegation behavior and nested sub-agent workflows; the code can be repaired only after maintainers pick the prompt-policy owner and default behavior.

options.title: Consolidate into current delegation path
options.body: Remove the parallel Tooling rubric and update the existing config-gated sub-agent delegation guidance/tests, preserving `maxSpawnDepth`-aware nesting behavior.

options.title: Accept broad default prompt guidance
options.body: Keep a default Tooling rubric, but explicitly accept the behavior change and repair the nested-spawn wording so configured nesting still works.

options.title: Pause for Codex-specific guardrail
options.body: Leave core prompt defaults alone and let the narrower related Codex delegation PR own Codex-specific steering.

recommendation.title: Consolidate into current delegation path
recommendation.body: Remove the parallel Tooling rubric and update the existing config-gated sub-agent delegation guidance/tests, preserving `maxSpawnDepth`-aware nesting behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored the current main sub-agent prompt and max-depth implementation that this PR would overlap or override.
